# Alavi Hospitals

> Alavi Hospitals is a premier multi-speciality healthcare network in Hyderabad, Telangana, providing patient-centric medical care, advanced diagnostic facilities, emergency support, and specialized clinical treatments across multiple locations.

## Hospital Locations

- **IDPL Branch**: 12-234, Adarsh Nagar Main Road, Opp. IDPL Colony, Balanagar, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Telangana 500037
- **Chintal Branch**: 5-120/2, Jeedimetla Main Road, Opp. Asian Sha Theater, Shiva Nagar, Chintal, Hyderabad, Telangana 500054

- **Appointments & Support**: +91 9603 911 911

## Core Specialities & Clinical Departments

- **General Medicine & Diabetology**: Comprehensive care for chronic metabolic conditions, diabetes management, and infectious diseases.
- **Pediatrics & NICU**: Neonatal intensive care unit, premature baby care, pediatric viral infection treatments, and child vaccination programs.
- **Obstetrics & Gynecology**: High-risk pregnancy management, normal and operative deliveries, and comprehensive women's healthcare.
- **Cardiology**: Preventive cardiac care, diagnostic cardiology, and heart disease management.
- **Orthopedics**: Joint care, fracture management, and orthopedic surgeries.
- **Neurology**: Treatment for neurological conditions, stroke care, and nerve disorders.
- **Oncology**: Cancer screenings, specialized consultations, and oncological treatments.
- **General & Laparoscopic Surgery**: Minimally invasive surgical procedures and acute emergency surgeries.
- **Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation**: Post-surgical rehabilitation, joint mobility, and physical therapy.

## Key Medical Leadership & Specialists

- **Dr. M. Chandra Shekar**: Senior Consultant in General Medicine & Diabetology
- **Dr. Pradeep Reddy**: Senior Pediatrician & Neonatologist (NICU Specialist)
- **Dr. Kalyani**: Senior Gynecologist & Obstetrician
- **Dr. Rabbani**: General Medicine Specialist

## Primary Website Pages & Documentation

- [Homepage](https://alavihospitals.in/): Overview of hospital services, emergency care, specialities, and quick appointment booking.
- [About Us](https://alavihospitals.in/about): Hospital mission, values, medical excellence, healthcare milestones, and leadership team.
- [Specialities](https://alavihospitals.in/specialities): Complete directory of medical departments and clinical services.
- [Doctors](https://alavihospitals.in/doctors): Profiles, qualifications, experience, and consultation schedules of consultant doctors.
- [Second Opinion](https://alavihospitals.in/second-opinion): Specialist medical second opinion services for complex diagnoses and treatment plans.
- [Health Packages](https://alavihospitals.in/health-packages): Preventive health checkup packages tailored for individuals, seniors, and families.
- [Vaccinations](https://alavihospitals.in/vaccinations): Pediatric immunization schedules and adult vaccination services.
- [Insurance & TPA](https://alavihospitals.in/insurance): Cashless hospitalization, empanelled insurance partners, and TPA support.
- [Health Library & Blog](https://alavihospitals.in/blog): Medical articles, health advice, disease prevention tips, and patient stories.
- [Patient & Visitor Guidelines](https://alavihospitals.in/patients): Admission procedures, visiting hours, patient rights, and visitor rules.
- [Contact Us](https://alavihospitals.in/contact): Branch addresses, interactive Google Maps location guides, contact numbers, and appointment query forms.

## API & System Endpoints (Internal Integration)

- **Submit Appointment / Contact Query**: `POST /api/forms/submit`
- **Get All Active Doctors**: `GET /api/doctors/getAllEnabledDoctors`
- **Get Specialities Directory**: `GET /api/speciality-pages/getAll`
- **Get Health Checkup Packages**: `GET /api/health-packages/getAllEnabled`
- **Get Second Opinion Services**: `GET /api/second-opinions/getAllEnabled`
- **Get Published Blogs**: `GET /api/blogs/getAllBlogs`
